sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Nestled in the Fasano countryside among olive trees and distant views of the Adriatic, Masseria Ficazzella is a restoration by Valari Studio that reimagines a historic Puglian farmhouse as a contemporary private home. Designed for a young, non-Italian family, the project balances architectural authenticity, domestic comfort, and a close relationship with the landscape.
